final: WITH c AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT c.store_id, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM c JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM r WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.store_id, r.cnt, r.ratio, r.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff FROM r JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
